title: Allahabad HC Fines Gulmohar Greens Builder Rs 25 Lakh, Orders Demolition Over GDA Collusion
case_name: Suresh Chander and 10 others v. State of U.P. and 2 others (with connected Gulmohur Greens Residents Welfare Association v. Ghaziabad Development Authority)
citation: 2026 LiveLaw (AB) 894, decided 27 October 2026 (Saral Srivastava and Sudhanshu Chauhan, JJ.)
card_summary: The Allahabad High Court found that Ghaziabad Development Authority officials colluded with the Gulmohar Greens promoter in repeatedly compounding building violations, letting flats be sold without a completion certificate. It set aside the compounding approval, ordered demolition of excess floors on several towers, and directed an FIR against the promoter, who must pay Rs 25 lakh to the residents' association.
card_tip: Buyers should check for a completion or occupancy certificate before taking possession; a repeated compounding approval from the development authority is not a substitute and can later be set aside.
verification_notes: Reported consistently by Bar & Bench and LiveLaw (English and Hindi editions) with matching figures (Rs 25 lakh cost, Rs 50,000 per petitioner, demolition of specified floors, FIR direction). Full judgment text not independently read; case citation taken from LiveLaw.
